summary: Grid-based entity visibility manager update. Clears the visibility allocation list at obj+0xE5C0, derives a per-frame work budget from DivisionWithCapComputation and a CRT float product, classifies the rank via ThresholdToRankClassifier (jump table jpt_4655B3) into a per-rank LOD factor, rebuilds a candidate entity list at obj+0xE5B0 from active slots, merge-sorts it, then dispatches visibility/computation work to each entity via DispatchWrapper under a budget cap (v83). Rank-out entities get a 432-byte progress-bar event (ProgressBarEventEncode + VectorToShort3Conversion) appended to obj+0xE5C0; remaining budget headroom is written back into the per-slot word. Entity identity and LOD/threshold bytes are read from per-entity data blocks via the obj+0xE5B8-cursor list chain.

local_names.v83: per-frame work budget (starts at v10, debited per dispatched entity)
local_names.v84: per-rank LOD factor selected by ThresholdToRankClassifier switch
local_names.v92: float form of the DivisionWithCapComputation result (v7)
local_names.v95: node list returned by sub_465D70 (payload + free-flag per node)

operations.description: v4 = *this + 14704 -> visibility allocation-list base obj+0xE5C0 (dereference of this); v5 = head pointer at *v4.
Free-walk of the list at obj+0E5C0: per node, ConditionalFreeByFlagCheck(node) then FreeWrapper_7bcf(node); node linkage follows the +8 next field.
Zero the 4-slot list header obj+0xE5C0..0xE5CC (head/tail/duplicate-ref/count) after freeing.
v7 = DivisionWithCapComputation(*this, a2): per-frame budget base value.
v90 = 560*a2 (byte stride into obj), v92 = v7; budget v83 = LOWORD(obj[140*a2+173]) + CRTFtol(*(float*)(obj+0x60) * *(float*)(obj+0x64) * v92); the source word obj[140*a2+173] is then zeroed.
Read the entity-list head from obj[27] = obj+0x6C and mirror it into the cursor slot obj+0x74.

Walk entities of the list at obj+0x6C (entity ptr from *(obj+0x6C)); skip those whose +0x1AC dword equals a3; otherwise allocate a 12-byte node via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper, append it to the obj+0xE5C0 list (head/tail/dup/count update) and debit the budget v83 by -8-((entity type bits>>8)&0x3FF). Advance via cursor obj+0x74 with next entity from *(obj+0x74).
ThresholdToRankClassifier(v7) -> rank; a switch over it (jump table jpt_4655B3) selects the per-rank LOD factor v84: 0.125 / 0.083333336 / 0.0625 / 0.015625 / default 0.16666667.
v82 = dbl_8AFE90: constant read used as an argument to the UtilityFunction_4bb0 threshold test.
Proceed into the rebuild/dispatch block only if UtilityFunction_4bb0(slot, v82, v84) is true AND budget v83 > 0.
FloatFieldDecrementWithClamp(obj + 560*a2 + 140, v84): decay the per-slot field by the LOD factor.
v93 = v83 / 60: convert the budget into 60-unit dispatch steps.
If v93 > 0, free-walk the obj+0xE5B0 list (ConditionalFreeByFlagCheck + FreeWrapper_7bcf per node; entity ptr from *(obj+0xE5B0)) and zero the 4-slot header obj+0xE5B0..0xE5BC.

Rescan obj slot table indices 14596..14699: reset each obj[v25] = -1; for active entities (byte at obj+v24+248) with slot counter != a2, allocate a 12-byte node via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper and append it to the obj+0xE5B0 list (head/tail/dup/count), stepping v24 by 560 per slot.
Select the grid rank/vehicle block: v29 = word_5F0F88[9312*v23]; if dword_5EF9A0[4656*v29] == -1 then v29 = v23; entity data base v32 = unk_5EC6D8 + 18624*v29 (per-rank vehicle array, 0x48C0 stride).
Walk the rebuilt obj+0xE5B0 list; for each entity call ShortComputation_4990(entity, v32); advance via cursor obj+0xE5B8 with the next entity read from *(obj+0xE5B8).
MergeSortOnLinkedList(list at obj+0xE5B0) -> sorted head; write back head into obj+0xE5B0, tail into obj+0xE5B4 and duplicate head ref into obj+0xE5B8.
Second pass over the sorted obj+0xE5B0 list: write each obj slot obj[14596..14699] = (unsigned __int8) entity data byte at +0x6D read through the obj+0xE5B0 list.
dword_7CD2AC = *this: publish the object base pointer to the global.

Build the second dispatch chain from the obj+0x7C list (guard: head == 0 skips the whole block): per entity v49 (from *(obj+0x7C)) whose +0x1AC dword != a3, allocate 4-byte and 12-byte nodes via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper; advance via cursor obj+0x84 with next entity from *(obj+0x84).
v95 = sub_465D70(chain head v94): produces the per-entity (payload pointer, free-flag byte) node list used by the priority dispatch drain.
v89 = (v93 > 1) ? v93/2 : v83/60: per-frame dispatch-count cap.

Main dispatch loop while budget v83 > 0: pull the next entity from the obj+0xE5B0 list via cursor obj+0xE5B8; skip entities failing the filter — entity data byte +0x6C cleared or CharacterRangeCheckWithSignFlag(entity, a2, slot flag) false; otherwise dispatch DispatchWrapper(entity, a2).

Per dispatched entity (chain rooted at obj+0xE5B8) with +0x219 dword != a3: if dispatch cap v89 is exhausted (<0), allocate a 432-byte block, encode ProgressBarEventEncode(1, 7, 19, entity byte +0x6D, entity float +0x71, 0) and VectorToShort3Conversion, append a wrapper node to the obj+0xE5C0 list and budget v83 -= 8+((block>>8)&0x3FF); otherwise (data block not the -109 sentinel, guard) append a node referencing entity+109 to obj+0xE5C0 and budget v83 -= 60.

Drain the v95/v86 node chain into the obj+0xE5C0 list: per remaining node allocate a 12-byte wrapper, append it, and budget v83 -= 8+((payload>>8)&0x3FF); stop when v83 <= 0 or no dispatch source remains.
Free the v95 chain: per node, if its +8 free-flag byte is set call FreeWrapper_7bcf on the payload; then FreeWrapper_7bcf on the node itself.
result = obj+0xE5C0; store the list head into obj+0xE5C8; if budget v83 > 0 write min(CRTFtol(v92*v84), v83) into the per-slot word obj+560*a2+692; return result.
